parent: results/expectation_realization_v1/PROTOCOL.json (stage A, amendment A1) and its run run_20260927 (Step 450)

questions.Q1_filter: Does removing every channel whose Dawid-Skene balanced accuracy estimate is <= 0.5 remove the channels that are truly anti-oriented (and only those)?
questions.Q2_partition: Is the L-SML partition of the surviving channels, found on their binary marks, identical across the 5 folds and equal to the 13-channel partition restricted to the survivors?
questions.Q3_group_estimates: Are the Dawid-Skene estimates of sensitivity, specificity and prevalence accurate when each discovered group votes once (group representative) instead of each channel?
questions.Q4_rule: Does the decision rule built from the estimated group properties (maximum-likelihood log-odds weights learned on binary marks, applied to the continuous group scores) beat averaging all 13 channels on PRMBench, beat equal weights on the same groups, and beat channel-level estimated weights?
questions.Q5_continuous: Does continuous L-SML on the surviving channels beat L-SML on all 13 channels, and beat averaging the survivors?

population: unchanged from stage A: 13,769 answers, source_groups_v2 folds, outer fold k evaluated, calibration fold (k+1)%5 sets only the PRMScore threshold, fitting on the other three folds; 13 answer-standardized channels (bank11 + realized_z + realized_drv). Input files must hash-equal the stage-A INPUT_MANIFEST

label_free_chain.rows: every label-free estimation step (marks statistics, Dawid-Skene, partition) uses the PRMBench steps of the three fit folds with uniform weights, as stage A did, so that the stage-A truth can be computed on the same rows. S_lsml is fitted on all fit-fold steps (both benchmarks) exactly like the stage-A B13_lsml, so contrast 4 isolates channel removal
label_free_chain.1_marks: per answer and channel: +1 for the top ceil(0.2 n) steps, -1 otherwise. Boundary ties are broken by a uniform random key (numpy default_rng(20260928), one key per step and column, fixed for the run), NOT by position: stage A found boundary ties in 16.7% of answer-channel cells (dominant_freq16 86%, top15_turnover 49%) resolved toward early steps
label_free_chain.2_filter: Dawid-Skene EM (cvf_v2 em.fit_em 'ds', spectral initialization, as stage A) on the 13 channels' marks; channel i survives iff its estimated balanced accuracy pi_hat_i = (psi_hat_i + eta_hat_i)/2 > 0.5. Fewer than 3 survivors or an EM failure = every stage-B arm of that fold is unscored (no fallback)
label_free_chain.3_partition: L-SML grouping of the survivors on their answer-centred marks (tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled, standardize, unit loading scale: the recipe whose 13-channel partition equalled the three declared families in all 5 stage-A folds). The same grouping on all 13 channels is computed for Q2 only
label_free_chain.4_group_scores: continuous group score = answer re-standardized mean of the member channels (answer-standardized values); binary group representative = top-20% marks of that score with its own random tie key (default_rng(20260929))
label_free_chain.5_group_estimates: Dawid-Skene EM on the group representatives' marks (needs >= 3 groups; otherwise G_sml is unscored in that fold). The truth on the same rows is computed for the diagnostic only
label_free_chain.6_rule: weight of group g = max(0, log(psi_g eta_g / ((1-psi_g)(1-eta_g)))) with psi, eta clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4] (the Parisi et al. 2014 maximum-likelihood vote weight; positive exactly when pi_g > 0.5), normalized to sum 1; step score = sum_g w_g * continuous group score. All weights 0 = unscored

stage_B_controls.G_equal: equal weights on the same discovered groups' continuous scores (discovered-group block-equal)
stage_B_controls.C_sml: channel-level rule: max(0, log alpha_i) from the 13-channel Dawid-Skene estimates of step 2, applied to the answer-standardized channels (no grouping; filtered channels get weight 0 automatically)
stage_B_controls.S_equal: equal weights on the surviving channels
stage_B_controls.S_lsml: CONT L-SML (fit_fusion_weights 'continuous', small_m_guard, FIT_SEED 20260919) on the surviving channels, fitted on all fit-fold steps; orientation anchor q15_H1 if it survives, otherwise the survivor with the largest pi_hat
stage_B_controls.G_oracle: DIAGNOSTIC, LABEL-USING, NEVER A CANDIDATE: the same group weights computed from the TRUE psi, eta of the group representatives on the fit-fold PRMBench steps. Measures the headroom of the rule if the estimates were perfect

arms.references_refitted_and_replayed: B13_equal, B13_block_equal (declared blocks), B13_lsml, B11_lsml, B11_equal, ct7, fam421: refitted per fold and required to equal the stage-A STEP_SCORES.npz evaluation rows (<= 1e-9; hard stop otherwise); PRMScore thresholds from the same fold models
arms.position_reference: step_index: the 0-based step index as the step score (stage-A red team: 0.662 within-answer on PRMBench)
arms.position_controlled_replicate: the whole label-free chain and the arms G_sml, G_equal, C_sml, S_equal, S_lsml, G_oracle and B13_equal repeated on a position-adjusted bank (suffix _pos): each answer-standardized channel minus its label-free mean at (answer step count, step index) over the PRMBench fit-fold steps (unseen keys: 0), then answer re-standardized. Stage-A red team: drv's positional profile alone scores 0.651
arms.tie_seed_stability: the chain on the original bank repeated with tie keys from default_rng(20260930) and default_rng(20260931) (suffixes _tie2, _tie3); survivors, partitions, weights and metrics reported, no contrasts

endpoints: unchanged from stage A: PRMBench within-answer AUC and official PRMScore (primary), any-error hit (secondary), ProcessBench gate-free SLA macro over 8 cells (reported beside)

primary: does the binary-property rule beat averaging all 13 channels (the stated goal)
do the estimated weights add over equal weights on the same discovered groups
does estimating per discovered group beat estimating per channel
does removing the estimated-weak channels help continuous L-SML
does continuous L-SML add over averaging the survivors
contrasts.primary_family: 5 contrasts x 2 PRMBench endpoints (within-AUC, PRMScore) = 10; Bonferroni-adjusted intervals from 100,000 paired source-group bootstrap draws (seed 20260927), on the folds both arms cover
contrasts.secondary: every stage-B arm vs B13_equal, B13_block_equal, B13_lsml, B11_lsml, ct7, fam421 and step_index; S_equal - B13_equal; G_oracle - G_equal; G_oracle - G_sml; position replicate: G_sml_pos - B13_equal_pos, G_sml_pos - G_equal_pos, S_lsml_pos - S_equal_pos; ProcessBench SLA of every pair (100,000 paired draws over ProcessBench source groups, percentile intervals, no correction)

diagnostic_bars.Q1: per fold: the set of dropped channels vs the set with true pi <= 0.5 on the same rows (both lists reported; no bar)
diagnostic_bars.Q2: per fold partition of the survivors, adjusted Rand index between every pair of folds, and equality with the 13-channel partition restricted to the survivors
diagnostic_bars.Q3_bar: group estimates are called accurate in a fold only if (a) |prevalence_hat - prevalence_true| <= 0.05; (b) every group with |pi_true - 0.5| > 0.02 is on the correct side of 0.5; (c) rank: Spearman(pi_hat, pi_true) >= 0.80 when there are >= 4 groups, the identical order when there are 3. Also reported: MAE of psi and eta, and the Spearman between estimated and oracle weights. The bar does not gate scoring: if it fails, any G_sml result cannot be attributed to accurate estimates

decision: G_sml meets Omri's goal on PRMBench if contrast 1 has a Bonferroni-adjusted within-AUC interval above 0 AND a PRMScore point delta >= 0. Reported with its position-replicate contrast, tie-seed stability, Q3 bar and ProcessBench SLA. Candidate for the external benchmarks = the stage-B arm (G_sml, G_equal, C_sml, S_equal, S_lsml) with the highest PRMBench within-AUC; whether it goes to the external lock is decided WITH Omri. No arm is promoted by this run

predictions_frozen.P1: the filter drops energy_innovation and top50_js in all 5 folds; no channel with true pi > 0.52 is dropped
predictions_frozen.P2: the survivors' partition is identical in all 5 folds and equals the 13-channel partition restricted to the survivors
predictions_frozen.P3: group-level prevalence error is smaller than channel-level prevalence error in every fold, but the Q3 bar still fails in at least 3 of 5 folds (a shared step-length factor across groups)
predictions_frozen.P8: on the position-adjusted bank, G_sml_pos - B13_equal_pos is smaller than G_sml - B13_equal
predictions_frozen.P9: every stage-B arm is below ct7 on ProcessBench SLA

hard_stops: input file hashes differ from the stage-A INPUT_MANIFEST
answer order / step counts differ from JOINED
any refitted reference differs from the stage-A evaluation-row scores by more than 1e-9
stage-A within-AUC of B13_equal, B13_lsml, B11_lsml, ct7 not reproduced within 1e-9
any mark column without exactly ceil(0.2 n) marks
any arm writes an evaluation row twice
failed_fit_policy: amendment A1 of stage A: a failed fit leaves its evaluation rows unscored, no fallback; arms are evaluated on the folds where they were fitted and paired contrasts use the common folds
